Simple Tomato Soup

Heat two tablespoons of olive oil in a large pan. Add one chopped onion and cook for five minutes until soft.

Add two cloves of garlic and 800 g of chopped tomatoes. Add salt and stir, then simmer for 20 minutes.

Blend until smooth. Taste, adjust the seasoning, and serve with fresh bread.
